subject: proj-dy
title: (R)PROJ.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 273 (CMBA-29). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT (social reality) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From SOC-RT: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From T-C-IMP: POST (postulation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and INFO-INTR (information interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-INTR: MT-RT-SIGN. From MT-RT-SIGN: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
